info.name: Medusa Storefront E2E - Checkout Flow Monitor Copy
info.description:
End-to-end synthetic monitor for the Medusa Storefront (Store) API.

Simulates a real shopper: browse products -> register/login -> build a cart -> choose shipping -> pay -> complete the order -> verify the order persisted correctly.

Designed to run unattended via Newman in CI/CD or as a scheduled monitor. Each run creates a fresh, timestamped customer so it is safely repeatable against a shared environment (staging/production-like) without collisions.

Folders run in order (00 -> 06); do not reorder without checking variable dependencies.
